messages.text: Help me choose: explain the remaining questions in plain language. Keep my original task and the details I already provided.

Choose Cedar Desk’s JSON fields
Category only returns damage, delivery, or other. Category + summary also gives a short human-readable explanation and is recommended for basic triage. Category + confidence adds the model’s self-reported confidence, which is not a calibrated or verified probability.

Cedar Desk JSON triage is configured at temperature zero. The verified test returned category “damage” with summary “A cracked mug.”, and the matching log shows status 200.
Add required boolean escalate: damage or delays over seven days. Test this prompt: CD-305 is nine days late, no damage. Check Logs.
The escalation policy and required boolean field were added. The test returned delivery with escalate true, and Logs verified status 200.
Test this prompt: CD-306 is exactly seven days late, no damage. Check Logs.
CD-306 returned category “delivery” with escalate false. The matching log shows the exact prompt and status 200, consistent with escalation only for delays over seven days.
Which rule escalated CD-305? Does zero temperature guarantee accuracy?

CD-305 escalated under the “delays over 7 days” rule because it was nine days late; the ticket explicitly said there was no damage. Temperature zero makes outputs more deterministic, but it does not guarantee accuracy.
Scroll the log dialog down to Output.
The log dialog is scrolled to Output, showing CD-306 as delivery with escalate false.
